institutionName: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University
collegeName: College of Agriculture and Environmental Sciences (CAES)
programName: Bachelor of Science in Agricultural Education — Professional Service
programDescription: The Agricultural Education — Professional Service concentration prepares students for non-teaching careers in agricultural extension, training, communications, and program coordination. Graduates work with Cooperative Extension, USDA agencies, agricultural nonprofits, and industry training programs to deliver education and outreach to farmers, communities, and stakeholders across rural and urban settings.

careerOutlook.outlook: Extension and agricultural program professionals are vital to translating research into practice. HBCU-trained professionals are especially valued for their ability to connect with underserved farming communities and historically marginalized populations.
